title: DeImmu-MPNN: Reducing Immunogenicity Burden in De Novo Protein Design (code)
description:
Code accompanying the paper "DeImmu-MPNN: Reducing Immunogenicity Burden in De Novo Protein Design". A direct-preference-optimization (DPO) fine-tune of ProteinMPNN that redesigns protein sequences to reduce predicted MHC class II (T-helper) epitope burden, extending CAPE-MPNN (Gasser et al., 2025) from MHC class I to the anti-drug-antibody-relevant class II pathway.

The repository provides the application pipeline (redesign a monomer or binder-target complex, score MHC-II burden, validate binding with Boltz-2 and AF2 initial-guess), the DPO training entrypoint, the main-text evaluation scripts, the IEDB validation analysis (Supplementary S1), and IEDB data-preparation scripts.

It also includes the derived evaluation data behind every figure, table and quoted number in the paper, under data/, indexed by the claim each file supports in data/MANIFEST.md.

The nine trained checkpoints are deposited separately (see Related identifiers). Two classes of input are deliberately not redistributed: IEDB source records (IEDB terms of use) and the MHC-II position-weight-matrix training inputs, which are derived from netMHCIIpan output under a DTU academic licence. Both are regenerable from the scripts provided; the README documents the exact PWM build parameters.

License: MIT, retaining the original CAPE-MPNN copyright.
